title: Feature context
description: Test intent only — no build repos, no bundle ids; those are simsquad's job. project_dir is the one bridge to the app under test.

feature_id.description: Lowercase slug; becomes part of the run id and squad name, so it must survive simsquad name sanitisation unchanged.

project_dir.description: App project whose simsquad.toml defines the build. Defaults to the orchestrator's cwd.

matrix.description: Optional override; each entry maps verbatim onto --ios-spec / --android-spec. Omit to use the project's TOML matrix.

env.description: Passed through simsquad deploy --env; arrives on every device row.

smoke.description: Smoke goals the worker verifies against the real screen.
